description: This file defines an interface class 'MediaPlayerClientBackendInterface' for a media player backend in the 'firebolt::rialto::client' namespace. It declares virtual methods for media control operations such as create, load, play, pause, stop, seek, volume control, and source management, intended to be implemented by concrete classes.

classes.name: MediaPlayerClientBackendInterface
classes.description: An interface class defining the backend operations for a media player, including creation, source management, playback controls, and querying status.

methods.name: createMediaPlayerBackend
methods.description: Creates a media player backend with specified client and maximum dimensions.

methods.name: isMediaPlayerBackendCreated
methods.description: Checks if the media player backend has been created.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the media pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source by its identifier.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specific type with given MIME type and URL.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Checks if data is available based on media source status and request ID.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the media.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the position and size of the video window.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment for streaming or buffering.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a video frame.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the audio.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Checks if the audio is muted.
